name: Bubble Lens
description: Soap bubble lens with Marangoni convection — surface-tension gradients drive tangential flow along the film, which is why real bubble bands swirl rather than merely sagging — and per-band membrane resonance: eight drum modes of the film, one per FFT bin, perturbing the thickness so the bubble rings at the frequencies present in the audio. Retains the spring-damped pointer, satellite bubbles and film shockwaves; adds ACES, dataTextureC iridescent trails and a corrected A/B packing.
